output.title: Insulin copay cap on a Prescription Drug Plan (PDP)
output.draft_text:
Question: What is the insulin copay cap on a PDP?

Before you answer: Verify the caller first. Do not quote a copay, tier, or coverage limit to an unverified caller, and do not say whether a drug is on the formulary (see U-RX-EDU-001-07).

Answer for a verified member: On your Prescription Drug Plan, covered insulin has a cost-sharing cap of [cap amount] per [supply period, e.g., one-month supply]. The cap applies to insulins that are [coverage condition, e.g., on the plan formulary] and is filled at [pharmacy types the cap applies to]. The cap applies [whether the deductible applies to insulin] and in [coverage phases where the cap applies]. For a [longer supply period, e.g., 3-month supply], the cap is [cap amount for longer supply].

The cap [does / does not] apply to insulin used with [delivery method or device, e.g., insulin pumps], which is covered under [benefit that covers it].

To check what the member would pay for a specific insulin, look up the drug on the plan record in [system or tool name]. The estimate reflects the copay or coinsurance on the plan record (see U-RX-EDU-001-10). Do not promise that the pharmacy will charge the estimated amount (see U-RX-EDU-001-11).

If the member says they were charged more than the cap: [escalation or resolution steps, e.g., where to route the case and the timeframe].
placeholders: [coverage condition, e.g., on the plan formulary]
[delivery method or device, e.g., insulin pumps]
[escalation or resolution steps, e.g., where to route the case and the timeframe]
author_checklist: Confirm the insulin cost-sharing cap amount for PDPs and its source, such as the plan document or a regulatory requirement, and the effective plan year.
Confirm the supply period the cap applies to and the cap for extended-day supplies.
Confirm which insulins are covered by the cap, for example formulary status or tier.
Confirm whether the deductible applies to insulin and in which coverage phases the cap applies.
Confirm whether the cap applies at retail, mail-order, specialty, and out-of-network pharmacies.
Confirm how pump-administered insulin is treated and which benefit covers it.
Confirm whether the cap varies by plan or contract, and whether advocates must check the individual plan record.
Confirm the tool or system advocates use to look up a member's insulin cost.
Confirm the escalation path when a member reports being charged above the cap.
Confirm that the verification requirement and pricing disclaimers from U-RX-EDU-001-07, -10, and -11 are referenced correctly.
Have compliance or legal review the wording before approval.
